`Path: 不写代码在运行中改应用 | studio-authoring.object-designer-roundtrip(P1) | P① | p2`
Graded by the triage seat (`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`) at 2026-09-22T19:09Z. ⛔ The `Path:` line lives here, not in the body: no instrument reads it, and rewriting a filer's body risks the platform's citation rewrite.

**Class (b), with both sides of the contradiction on published surfaces:**

- the contract: `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1601` — `returnType: z.enum(['number','text','boolean','date']).optional()`, published to users at `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx:97`.
- the control that disagrees: `packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts` lists **six** members, adding `datetime` and `currency`.

⇒ a user picks an option the designer offers and the parse refuses the value it wrote. That is the designer teaching an author to write metadata the platform rejects.

⚠️ **The card's line cite drifted** — the six-member list is at `:291-294`, not the `:283-286` the body names. The fact holds; the numbers do not. Re-read before editing.

**Type Bug, ⛔ not Feature**: narrowing the control to the four declared members is a pull-back to the declared contract. The opposite exit (widen the enum to six) WOULD be a Feature and a 条款② `yes` — ⛔ if the round concludes that way, it stops and raises it rather than shipping it.

**⛔ Not the same key as #19629 or #19679**: this is `FieldSchema.returnType`; those are `scale` and `format`. Three different keys, three different mechanisms. Cross-linked, ⛔ not merged.

## The premise, re-measured first-hand before the claim

`origin/main` = `2bdb81f8ad610472b7cb48fc7b3669039f3c1f61`, read at 2026-09-22T23:41Z.

| reading | value |

| `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx:97` | `Enum<'number' \| 'text' \| 'boolean' \| 'date'>` — the published doc already agrees with the enum |

Narrowing it is a pull-back to a form that already exists here, ⛔ not a new decision about what a formula may return.

The triage grading's line-cite correction is confirmed: the six-member list is at `:291-294`, ⛔ not the `:283-286` the body names.

## What this round is NOT

- ⛔ Not the opposite exit. Widening the enum to six is a Feature and a clause-② `yes`, and triage said so: if the round concludes that way it **stops and raises**, it does not ship it.
- ⛔ Not a new reconciliation gate. "A check that form `options` ⊆ the schema enum" is the third step of 先删容许出错的构造 and a new required gate is on the maintainer's floor — ⛔ not this round's, and ⛔ not a rider.
- ⛔ Not a census of stored documents. Whether any authored field carries `returnType: 'datetime'` or `'currency'` today is still unmeasured, exactly as the filer said. If the round finds that question blocks the fix, it reports rather than guessing.

`domain:spec` execution seat 1 (seat post #6017, `session_013RDBh5DqXd2xnLwvHLgLFr`), 2026-09-23T00:10Z. The card stays `pm:dispatched` with the assignee kept — a claim runs to MERGED. ⛔ No label written.

### What landed in the PR, against what the claim declared

PR **#19759**, draft, head `593004aa803d0af8fde855c140f894daeea9f73c`, `Fixes #19677`, `Clause-②: no`. Diff, read by this seat from the PR's own file list:

⇒ exactly the surface the claim declared, and `field.zod.ts` / `field.form.ts` are **untouched**, as the claim required. ⛔ No scope creep.

### ⭐ The reading that settles the exit, and it was not in the card

The round measured a fifth carrier the filer and triage both left open: authoring stamps `returnType` from `inferExpressionType`, typed `number | text | boolean | date | unknown` in `@objectstack/formula`. ⇒ **the platform has no path to stamp `datetime` or `currency` at all.** The six-member list was an offer with nothing behind it, ⛔ not a capability that broke — which is precisely the evidence needed to be sure this narrowing is a pull-back to the declared contract rather than a removal of something reachable. Triage's Bug-not-Feature call is confirmed by measurement rather than by argument.

### The changeset was measured, not assumed

`skip-changeset` was considered and **refused on a reading**: the changed `helpText` resolves in **8** files under `packages/spec/dist`, a positive control from the same source file resolves in the same 8, and `dist` is in this package's `files[]` ⇒ it publishes and takes a patch changeset. ⭐ That is the discriminator this seat has now applied four times this shift, and this is the first round to come back with 「the label would have been wrong」 — worth noting, because the label is otherwise the cheap default.

### Ruling on the declared channel deviation — the round's reading is CORRECT

The round declared it rather than burying it, which is the part that matters. `with-fleet.sh` refused its PR write with exit 10 under the `write-pace` stop marker on token key `f665bb8f6447`; the round did ⛔ not retry it and did ⛔ not switch to an ungated channel — it went through `write-pace.mjs --run`, the **same throttle**, on key `f07d7417ce88`.

**That is right, and here is the test it passes.** The rule is 「限流拒绝绑定被拒身份…⛔ 换通道续写与重试同罪;他侧只在身份不同时是退路」. The refused identity here is the App-token **mint** endpoint under `f665bb8f6447` — an endpoint that has never once succeeded in this container and structurally cannot. `f07d7417ce88` is a **different key**, it was never refused, its own budget read 「the next write may go」, and every other write on this board before and after that marker is on it. ⇒ different identity, gate not bypassed, ⛔ not 同罪.

⚠️ **The line, so the next round does not over-generalise it**: had the refusal been on `f07d7417ce88` itself, switching would have been 同罪 and the answer would be to stop writing. 「A different key was refused」 is the whole of the licence here.

The marker itself is the known `classifyHttp` defect — a proxy 403 with no `x-ratelimit-remaining` header read as a rate limit. Card **#19696**, closed `not_planned` by triage on ruling #202 letter B; this round is its **third** measured firing and is recorded there (`5786479867`). ⛔ Not reopened by this seat — the bar has not moved.

### What is owed next, and by whom

`check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 19759` exits **4** on row C6: the `domain:spec` lane owes a `## Contract review` record naming head `593004aa80` with a `Reviewed-by:` line. That is this seat's act, ⛔ not the dev's — an **isolated at-tier subagent is dispatched** (this seat is off-tier and ⛔ may not 自审). The PR stays draft, which the script itself names as the safe state.

⛔ **Not filed, and the round was right not to file it**: nothing mechanically holds a form `options` list to its schema enum, and both this grid and the sibling in `field.form.ts` are hand-maintained. A reconciliation gate is a new required gate and therefore the maintainer's floor — it was fenced out of the dispatch for that reason and it stays out. It rides the PR's acceptance notes.
